title: Increase Muon matrix learning rate to 0.05
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (25%) to strengthen gradient signal for transformer matrices (>90% of parameters)
reflection: Result: val_bpb 0.996553 (tied baseline). The tight local optimum persists: all three agents independently converged on this same idea as the most promising untested lever, but increasing matrix LR provides no improvement. The 15x embedding-to-matrix LR ratio appears well-calibrated despite seeming extreme. This confirms the baseline is genuinely trapped in a tight attractor—single-parameter changes on fundamental optimizer knobs (LR ratios, weight decay, model capacity, MLP width) have all failed or been neutral across 3 rounds. Next steps would require either: (1) multi-parameter coordination (e.g., ADAM_BETAS + LR adjustment), (2) fundamentally different architectures (activations, attention patterns), or (3) accepting that the 5-minute budget with this hardware/tokenizer is already near-optimal for this model configuration.
